description: Pinned versions and digests for everything download-dependencies.ps1 places on disk outside node_modules (whose versions come from package-lock.json instead). Update this file in the same commit as any change to the pinned version in build-common.ps1.

node.verification: download-dependencies.ps1 downloads this archive's own SHASUMS256.txt at install time and checks it against this pinned digest before trusting or extracting it; a mismatch on either check aborts the install.

projectDependencies.note: Every project dependency version and digest is pinned by package-lock.json; npm ci refuses to install anything that does not match it.
